# Medical & Surgical Solutions

> Medical & Surgical Solutions (MSS) delivers trusted, high-quality medical and
> surgical equipment to healthcare professionals, hospitals, and institutions
> in India. Products span medical devices, surgical supplies, and healthcare
> equipment, with cash-on-delivery and online payment options.

## Site

- [Home](https://medicalsurgicalsolutions.com/): Storefront homepage — featured, trending, and on-sale products.
- [Shop](https://medicalsurgicalsolutions.com/shop): Full product catalog with category, brand, and price filters.
- [About Us](https://medicalsurgicalsolutions.com/about): Company background and mission.
- [Blog](https://medicalsurgicalsolutions.com/blog): Articles on medical equipment and healthcare topics.
- [Awards](https://medicalsurgicalsolutions.com/award): Recognitions and certifications.
- [Contact](https://medicalsurgicalsolutions.com/contact): Store contact details and support.
- [FAQ](https://medicalsurgicalsolutions.com/faq): Common questions about ordering, shipping, and returns.

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://medicalsurgicalsolutions.com/privacy-policy)
- [Terms & Conditions](https://medicalsurgicalsolutions.com/terms-conditions)
- [Return Policy](https://medicalsurgicalsolutions.com/return-policy)

## Notes

- The full, current list of products and blog posts is published in the
  sitemap: https://medicalsurgicalsolutions.com/api/sitemap.xml
- Orders require a valid prescription upload where applicable; shipping is
  handled via DTDC courier across India.
